service.description: File or change a proposed change of a sales order (ChangeProposal): its kind, reason, the order revision it is made against (the current one when empty; another is refused, STALE_ORDER naming it), the customer's consent, the commercial kinds' address, ship method or carrier, the case it came from, and its lines, each naming an order line (orderItemSeqId) with its action (OclCancel, OclSubstitute, OclPrice, OclQuantity, OclShipDate), the product, quantity and unit, the ship date (requiredByDate) and the proposed unit price. A cancel line cancels at most the line's open remainder, never what shipped (ALREADY_SHIPPED); a substitute line names a short pick of the line (pickExceptionId) and a product that is a current PatEquivalent or PatReplacement of the line's product and usable for sale (check#ProductUsable; SUBSTITUTE_INVALID, PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE), at most the short quantity, with the customer's consent (CONSENT_REQUIRED). Saving an existing proposal (requestId) replaces its lines and moves its revision, so earlier decisions no longer count; an applied, withdrawn or rejected one is refused (CHANGE_CLOSED). The proposal goes to its approvers (OrderChangeApproval): ORDER_CHANGE_APPROVE holders for cancel and substitute, SALES_APPROVE holders for the commercial kinds. Requires ORDER_CHANGE_REQUEST and an order of the user's organizations; without it a customer contact (the customer's own party, or a current contact or employee of it) may file a cancel of their own order, which under the organization's ServicePolicy.customerImmediateCancel (off by default) is applied at once, with the policy as its decision, while nothing on its lines is reserved, picked, shipped or invoiced and the order is not approved (immediate); otherwise it waits for an agent ("Cancellation requested"). Refuses a missing or another organization's order alike (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), an order that is not open, placed, approved or held (ORDER_STATE), an unknown kind or action (KIND_INVALID, ACTION_INVALID), a line of another order (LINE_UNAVAILABLE), no lines for a line kind (LINES_REQUIRED) and a quantity not above zero (QUANTITY_INVALID). The same operation key answers the first result.

parameter.name: reason
parameter.description: Why the change is asked for (the request's description)

parameter.name: lines
parameter.description: Each a map: orderItemSeqId, changeActionEnumId, productId, quantity, quantityUomId, requiredByDate, proposedUnitAmount, pickExceptionId

service.description: Withdraw a proposal not applied yet (OrderChanges' withdraw): the request Cancelled with its reason, kept with its history, and its approvers' notices read. The person who filed it, or an approver of its kind (ORDER_CHANGE_APPROVE, SALES_APPROVE). Refuses an applied or closed one (CHANGE_CLOSED), no reason (REASON_REQUIRED) and as get#OrderChange does.

One proposal for OrderChangeDetail: the request (kind, state, reason, consent, the case, who asked and when), its revision and the order's, its lines with their order lines, its decisions (current or not, expiry), the applied change's stored PDF, and what the user may do (save, decide, apply, withdraw), each false with the reason when not. Prices and amounts only for a price or finance reader (PRICE_VIEW, ACCOUNTING_VIEW, RECEIVABLE_VIEW, ORDER_APPROVE), else withheld. Requires ORDER_CHANGE_REQUEST, ORDER_CHANGE_APPROVE, ORDER_CHANGE_APPLY, SALES_APPROVE or SALES_ORDER_CHANGE (PERMISSION_DENIED), or the filer; refuses a missing proposal, another type and another organization's alike (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

ChangeImpact, writing nothing: for each line the order line before and after, its reserved, picked, issued (packed), shipped and billed quantities, a substitute's evidence (the association, usability, the price the order's resolver gives, get#OrderProductPrice, and the stock available to promise at the order's facility), the order's paid amount for a finance reader, and the conflicts apply would refuse (STALE_ORDER, ALREADY_SHIPPED, BILLING_CONFLICT, the packed quantity a reopen takes back, a finalized pack invoice), with previewVersion, the fingerprint of the fulfillment facts apply compares (STOCK_CHANGED). Prices as get#OrderChange. Requires the read permissions of get#OrderChange.

Approve or refuse a proposal at its revision (ChangeDecision): an OrderChangeDecision bound to the revision and the order's revision, with the reason and, for an approval, its expiry (ServicePolicy orderChangeApprovalDays, else 7 days); the approvers' notices read. A refusal also closes the proposal (Cancelled, RrRejected). Requires ORDER_CHANGE_APPROVE for cancel and substitute, SALES_APPROVE for the commercial kinds (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses the revision missing (REVISION_REQUIRED) or not the current one, naming it (STALE_REVISION), an order that changed since the proposal (STALE_ORDER), the person who proposed it unless the policy's orderChangeSelfApproval is Y (SELF_APPROVAL), a closed proposal (CHANGE_CLOSED), a refusal without a reason (REASON_REQUIRED), a decision other than approve or refuse (DECISION_INVALID) and as get#OrderChange does. The same operation key answers the first result.

The approve service of the OrderChangeApproval topic (F45, F46), which the framework's decide#NotificationMessage calls as the user: decide#OrderChange at the revision in the message (sourceRevision), so a superseded proposal is refused naming the current revision and a message with none is refused (REVISION_REQUIRED); another record is SOURCE_INVALID.
The refuse service of the OrderChangeApproval topic, with the reason: decide#OrderChange's refusal at the message's revision; refuses as approve#OrderChangeMessage does.

Apply an approved cancel or substitute proposal (ApplyChange; D9, D7) once confirmed (CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED), every check repeated under the order's lock. The order is held through hold#Order with the Change reason (OhtChange) and released through release#OrderHold, which leaves any other open hold (a Credit hold of Accounting) in place. A cancel line is cancel#OrderItem of its quantity (the line's remainder re-reserved on its picked stock, F262; picked stock above the line flagged ShipmentItemSource.putBackQuantity for Warehouse's reverse#Pick; no reduce#AssetReservation, F66). Between pack and ship the packed quantity first comes off the package through reopen#ShipmentPackageForChange (the in-process pack invoice's lines released). A substitute line adds the substitute (create#OrderItem: priced by the order's resolver, checked usable, reserved), cancels the short remainder of the line, marks the short pick SpresSubstitute and, once the hold is released, adds the substitute to the short pick's shipment for Warehouse to pick (add#OrderPartToShipment). The proposal is then Completed and the applied change's PDF stored as OrderContent (OctOrderChangeApplied; a render that fails is logged and the change stays). The named failures, each leaving the order unchanged: STALE_ORDER (StaleOrder: the order's revision is not the proposal's, naming it), STOCK_CHANGED (StockChanged: what is reserved, picked, packed or shipped differs from the preview's previewVersion), ALREADY_SHIPPED (AlreadyShipped: a return handles it), BILLING_CONFLICT (BillingConflict: a finalized invoice bills the quantity), APPROVAL_EXPIRED (ApprovalExpired), FORBIDDEN (Forbidden: a commercial kind, applied by the order's owner) and CLOSED_PERIOD (ClosedPeriod: the organization's fiscal period of today is closed); also STALE_REVISION (the proposal changed since its approval, naming the current revision), NOT_APPROVED, CHANGE_CLOSED and PREVIEW_REQUIRED. Requires ORDER_CHANGE_APPLY (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an order of the user's organizations; it never calls release#ShipmentDraftInvoice or refund#OrderPayment. The same operation key answers the first result.

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: requestId, orderId, statusId (the order's), orderRevision, cancelled (orderItemSeqId, quantity), added (orderItemSeqId, productId, quantity), reopened (shipmentId, shipmentPackageSeqId, productId, quantity), stillHeld, orderContentId, alreadyApplied

service.description: The order-change confirmation email: the applied change's stored PDF to a checked recipient (an address of the customer or of a current contact, employee or representative of it) as a mail client draft of an account the user sends from, through send#EmailDraft filed on the order, recorded as an OrderEmailMessage naming the content it sent. A send that fails leaves the change applied, its delivery pending; it is never applied again. Requires ORDER_CHANGE_APPLY or SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT; refuses a proposal not applied (NOT_APPLIED), no stored PDF (NOT_STORED), RECIPIENT_REQUIRED, RECIPIENT_INVALID, RECIPIENT_UNCHECKED and SEND_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED. The same operation key answers the first result.

OrderChanges' and Sales' ChangeList: the proposals of the user's organizations' sales orders, newest first, by order, customer, organization, the person who asked, the approver, the state (requested, needsInfo, approved, applied, rejected, cancelled, stale) and the period asked in, a page at a time; each row with its order and the order's current revision, the kind, the requested lines in words, the reason, who asked and when, the decision and the approver, a hold or conflict, and the state. Requires the read permissions of get#OrderChange.

requestOrderCancel: the signed-in account asks to cancel the open remainder of chosen lines of its customer's order, with the reason and its consent: a cancel-kind proposal through save#OrderChange on the Support app's claim for the customer, applied at once only under customerImmediateCancel ("Cancelled"), else "Cancellation requested" for an agent in OrderChanges. The same operationId answers the first result.
getOrderCancelRequest (F162): the customer's read of its cancel request: its state in the customer's words, its lines and whether the filer may withdraw it; never a decision's reason or approver.
withdrawOrderCancel (F162): the filer withdraws an open cancel request of their own (withdraw#OrderChange's own path).
